newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek stocks rally convincingly, seen strong in Dec.
newsitem.headline: Greek stocks rally convincingly, seen strong in Dec.

text.p: Greek shares rallied on Thursday adding on to recent gains with trading volume boosted by active block trading. Construction shares and banks led the advance with the sectoral indices climbing 4.12 and 3.0 percent.

"This seems to be a year-end rally that will continue through December. I consider the levels of the share price index to be still quite attractive," said broker Dimitris Matsaganis at National Securities.
The bourse rally was also the outcome of an improvement in market sentiment said broker Geli Petroulaki at Ergo Securities.

Meanwhile, the farmers' blockade went into its 22nd day with farmers descending to demonstrate in Athens. Farmers gathered in front of the Agriculture Ministry demanding a face-to-face meeting with Prime Minister Costas Simitis.

The Athens general share index closed up 2.05 percent or 18.92 points higher at 943.71 from Wednesday's 924.79 close after opening at 925.27. Trading volume jumped to 12.83 billion drachmas on volume of 5.5 million shares.
